description: This file 'utils.py' contains utility functions and classes for health checking a Kubernetes environment, including fetching kubeconfig, listing nodes and pods, parsing logs and metrics, performing connectivity checks, and sending reports to Kafka and Loki. It provides core functionalities for health monitoring and external integrations within a health check system.

classes.name: HealthResult
classes.description: A data class representing the aggregate health check result, including site info, environment, timestamp, node and pod statuses, connectivity, metrics, overall status, and a summary.

methods.name: logging.Logger setup_logging(level: str = "INFO")
methods.description: Configures logging with specified log level.

methods.name: str fetch_kubeconfig_from_vault(vault_addr: str, token: str, secret_path: str, timeout: float = 8.0)
methods.description: Retrieves kubeconfig content from HashiCorp Vault given address, token, and secret path.

methods.name: Tuple[client.CoreV1Api,client.AppsV1Api] build_k8s_client_from_kubeconfig(kubeconfig_content: str)
methods.description: Creates Kubernetes API clients using kubeconfig content.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_nodes(core_api: client.CoreV1Api, label_selector: str)
methods.description: Lists Kubernetes nodes with their labels, conditions, allocatable resources, and readiness status.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_pods(core_api: client.CoreV1Api, namespace: str, label_selector: str)
methods.description: Lists pods in a namespace with label selector, including container statuses and phases.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] collect_logs_and_metrics(core_api: client.CoreV1Api, namespace: str, pods: List[Dict[str, Any]], max_bytes: int = 50000)
methods.description: Fetches logs from pods, parses metrics, and detects anomalies.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] tcp_connectivity_check(host: Optional[str], port: int, timeout: float)
methods.description: Checks TCP connectivity to a specified host and port.

methods.name: HealthResult build_health_report( site_id: Optional[str], environment: str, nodes: List[Dict[str, Any]], pods: List[Dict[str, Any]], connectivity: Dict[str, Any], metrics: Dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Assembles a structured health report including node/pod statuses, connectivity, and metrics.

methods.name: None send_to_kafka(bootstrap_servers: str, topic: str, payload: Dict[str, Any], logger: logging.Logger)
methods.description: Sends a health report payload to a Kafka topic.

methods.name: None push_to_loki(loki_url: str, tenant_id: Optional[str], labels: str, entries: List[Dict[str, Any]], logger: logging.Logger)
methods.description: Pushes logs and entries to Loki via HTTP API with optional tenant ID.
